entries.name: UBT251 / NN9559
entries.stage: Chinese Phase 2 results; global Phase 1b/2a ongoing
entries.summary: Novo Nordisk and United Biotechnology sponsor-reported evidence describes once-weekly injectable UBT251 as a GLP-1/GIP/glucagon triple agonist. A Chinese Phase 2 obesity study reported up to 19.7% mean weight loss after 24 weeks; Novo's later pipeline presentation records a separate global Phase 1b/2a obesity study as ongoing.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for UBT251 or this formulation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development, licensing rights or a registry listing does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: The numerical findings are sponsor-reported and do not support cross-trial comparisons. Novo's September 2026 expectation to initiate weight-management Phase 3 in mid-2027 is a plan, not a completed event, result or regulatory decision.
